transport.title: BMTA buses
transport.text: A1 goes to Mo Chit 2 from 05:45 to midnight and A2 to Victory Monument from 06:00 to 23:00; both depart every 15 minutes and cost 30 THB. A3 to Lumpini Park and A4 to Sanam Luang run from 06:00 to 23:00 every 30 minutes, with a fare of 50 THB. Boarding points are in front of Service Hall and in the public arrivals area of Terminal 1 on Level 1.

taxi.title: Metered taxis
taxi.text: A surcharge of 50 THB is added to the metered fare, and passengers pay the expressway and special toll-road charges. Taxi counters are in the public arrivals areas on Level 1 of Terminals 1 and 2.

wifi.title: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.text: Select Airport Free Wi-Fi by NT, enter your email address and tick the box agreeing to the terms of use. After connecting successfully, click OK: free access is provided for 60 minutes.
